description:
About Anatomy

Anatomy is building the financial operating system for healthcare. We combine AI-powered lockbox services, EOB conversion, automated reconciliation, and banking to eliminate the manual work involved in getting healthcare providers paid.

We're a fast-growing, venture-backed company working with healthcare providers, billing companies, and leading healthcare technology platforms to modernize how money moves through healthcare.

About the Role

We're looking for a driven, highly organized Account Executive to join our growing sales team. You'll own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery through product demonstrations, negotiation, and close.

This is a high-velocity, consultative sales role focused on healthcare organizations and revenue cycle teams. You'll manage a broad pipeline of opportunities, build relationships with multiple decision-makers, and consistently convert qualified prospects into customers.

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, knows how to prioritize across many active opportunities, and enjoys the momentum of closing new business regularly. You're equally comfortable running a discovery call with a revenue cycle leader, demonstrating a technology platform, and navigating the details required to get a deal across the finish line.

The ideal candidate is comfortable adapting quickly, making good decisions without perfect information, and helping shape what comes next. You know how to prioritize across many active opportunities and enjoy the momentum of closing new business regularly. You’re equally comfortable running a discovery call with a revenue cycle leader, demonstrating a technology platform, and navigating the details required to get a deal across the finish line.

What You'll Do

  • Own the full sales cycle: Prospect, qualify, demonstrate, negotiate, and close new business with healthcare providers, medical groups, and billing companies.

  • Manage a high-volume pipeline: Effectively manage a large portfolio of active opportunities, maintaining consistent follow-up, clear next steps, and strong pipeline hygiene.

  • Drive consistent bookings: Build a predictable sales motion with regular deal closures and strong monthly and quarterly performance.

  • Lead consultative sales conversations: Understand prospects' financial operations, revenue cycle challenges, and existing workflows to position Anatomy's solutions.

  • Deliver compelling product demonstrations: Clearly communicate Anatomy's value to both operational and executive stakeholders.

  • Develop outbound opportunities: Partner with marketing and business development while proactively generating your own pipeline.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with customer success, onboarding, product, and leadership to ensure successful customer launches.

  • Improve our sales playbook: Help refine messaging, qualification criteria, sales processes, and tactics as we scale.

What We're Looking For

  • 3–6+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience, including 2+ years owning and closing deals as an Account Executive.

  • Proven success in a high-velocity mid-market sales environment, with a track record of consistently exceeding quota.

  • Experience managing a large number of concurrent opportunities and moving deals efficiently through the pipeline.

  • Strong full-cycle sales skills, including prospecting, discovery, product demonstrations, objection handling, negotiation, and closing.

  • Exceptional organization, follow-through, and attention to detail. You know exactly where every deal stands and what needs to happen next.

  • Ability to communicate technical products and complex workflows in a simple, compelling way.

  • Comfortable selling to multiple stakeholders, including operations, finance, and executive decision-makers.

  • Self-starter mentality, strong sense of ownership, and enthusiasm for building in an early-stage, fast-growing company.
